mapper.sql: id, notification_id, channel, provider, provider_message_id, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, sent_at, created_at
mapper.insert: insert into nad_notification_delivery (notification_id, channel, provider, provider_message_id, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, sent_at, created_at) values (#{notificationId}, #{channel}, #{provider}, #{providerMessageId}, #{status}, 0, now(), #{sentAt}, now())

insert into nad_notification_delivery (notification_id, channel, provider, provider_message_id, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, sent_at, created_at) values
(#{d.notificationId}, #{d.channel}, #{d.provider}, #{d.providerMessageId}, #{d.status}, 0, now(), #{d.sentAt}, now())
mapper.select: select from nad_notification_delivery where status = 'PENDING' and next_attempt_at <= now() order by next_attempt_at asc, id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update nad_notification_delivery set status = 'SENT', attempts = attempts + 1, provider = #{provider}, provider_message_id = #{providerMessageId}, sent_at = #{sentAt}, last_error = null where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from nad_notification_delivery where status = #{status}
